spells.name: Arcane Light
spells.description: Create a small floating magical light that illuminates the surrounding area. The light follows you until the duration ends or you dismiss it.

spells.name: Divine Sign
spells.description: Create a harmless, visible sign of your faith such as a glowing symbol, whispered prayer, or brief holy radiance.

spells.name: Primal Whisper
spells.description: Produce a harmless natural effect such as rustling leaves, a faint animal call, a small breeze, or the scent of a nearby plant.

spells.name: Occult Mark
spells.description: Place a harmless supernatural mark on an object or surface. The mark is visible only to creatures capable of perceiving magical effects.

spells.name: Firebolt
spells.channel: Yes — Burn additional Diamonds after casting. Each additional Diamond deals +1 damage.
spells.description: Hurl a bolt of magical fire at an enemy. Make a Cunning magic attack. On a hit, deal 1 HP damage.

spells.name: Healing Touch
spells.description: Restore 2 HP to an ally you can touch.

spells.name: Primal Snare
spells.duration: Until end of target's next turn
spells.description: Roots, vines, or grasping natural energy restrain an enemy. Make a Dexterity magic attack. On a hit, the target's movement is reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn.

spells.name: Whispering Curse
spells.duration: Until end of target's next turn
spells.description: Whisper a fragment of supernatural dread into an enemy's mind. Make a Cunning magic attack. On a hit, the target suffers -1 on its next attack.

spells.name: Arcane Burst
spells.channel: Yes — Each additional Diamond Burned after casting deals +1 damage.
spells.description: Release a concentrated blast of magical energy. Make a Cunning magic attack. On a hit, deal 3 HP damage.

spells.name: Blessing of Courage
spells.description: Bless an ally with supernatural courage. The target gains +1 Spirit until the next Long Rest.

spells.name: Beast Strength
spells.description: Infuse an ally with primal strength. The target gains +1 Might until the next Long Rest.

spells.name: Shadow Grasp
spells.duration: Until end of target's next turn
spells.description: Spectral shadows seize an enemy. Make a Cunning magic attack. On a hit, deal 2 HP damage and prevent the target from taking Reactions until the end of its next turn.

spells.name: Chain Lightning
spells.channel: Yes — Each additional Diamond Burned after casting deals +1 damage to the primary target.
spells.description: Lightning leaps from your hand into an enemy. Make a Cunning magic attack. On a hit, deal 4 HP damage. A second nearby enemy takes 2 HP damage.

spells.name: Greater Restoration
spells.description: Restore 5 HP to an ally and end one ongoing harmful magical effect affecting them.

spells.name: Wildshape
spells.duration: Until next Long Rest or dismissed
spells.description: Transform into a powerful natural form. Gain +2 Might and +1 HP, but you cannot use weapons or cast spells while transformed.

spells.name: Spectral Bind
spells.duration: Until end of target's next turn
spells.description: Spectral chains bind an enemy in place. Make a Cunning magic attack. On a hit, deal 3 HP damage and prevent the target from moving.

spells.name: Meteor
spells.channel: Yes — Each additional Diamond Burned after casting deals +1 damage.
spells.description: Call down a devastating fragment of celestial fire. Make a Cunning magic attack. On a hit, deal 7 HP damage to the target and 3 HP damage to nearby enemies.

spells.name: Divine Sanctuary
spells.description: Surround an ally with protective divine power. The target cannot lose HP from the next attack that hits them.

spells.name: Ancient Titan
spells.description: Invoke the strength of an ancient primal giant. Gain +3 Might and increase your maximum HP by 3 for the duration.

spells.name: Nightmare
spells.duration: Until end of target's next turn
spells.description: Flood an enemy's mind with supernatural terror. Make a Cunning magic attack. On a hit, deal 5 HP damage and the target cannot willingly move toward you until the end of its next turn.

spells.name: Arcane Apocalypse
spells.channel: Yes — Each additional Diamond Burned after casting deals +1 damage.
spells.description: Unleash an overwhelming eruption of arcane energy. Make a Cunning magic attack. On a hit, deal 10 HP damage to the target and 5 HP damage to every nearby enemy.

spells.name: Miracle
spells.description: Call upon overwhelming divine power. Restore an ally to full HP and end all harmful conditions and magical effects affecting them.

spells.name: Avatar of the Wild
spells.description: Become a towering avatar of primal power. Gain +3 Might, +2 Dexterity, +5 HP, and your successful attacks deal +2 damage.

spells.name: Death's Command
spells.duration: Until end of target's next turn
spells.description: Command the boundary between life and death. Make a Cunning magic attack. On a hit, deal 8 HP damage. If the target is reduced to 0 HP, you may immediately restore 3 HP to an ally within Near range.
